title: Beautiful!!
text: Beautiful!!. These nightstands came pre-assembled (minus the legs) and I cannot say how thankful I am for that! They were packaged beyond well, lots of styrofoam to soften the blows of shipping and the corners were doubly protected. The quality of the product is excellent and it is very sturdy. They look exactly as they look in the product photos. They have just the right amount of distressing and the drawers are deep (and the top, smaller drawer is lined with velvet which is a nice touch). Excellent quality for an excellent price!
